source_text: Μεταμόρφωσις ἀνθρώποις μεμυθολόγηται· μεταμορφοῦνται δὲ παρ᾿ ὑμῖν καὶ οἱ θεοί.Δένδρον ἡ Ῥέα γίνεται, δράκων δὲ ὁ Ζεὺς διὰ τὴν Φερσέφατταν, αἴγειροι αἱ τοῦ Φαέθοντος ἀδελφαί, καὶ ἡ Λητὼ ζῶον εὐτελές, δι᾿ ἣν Ὀρτυγία Δῆλος ἡ νῦν κέκληται. Θεὸς εἰπέ μοι κύκνος γίνεται, καὶ τὴν ἀετοῦ μορφὴν ἀναλαμβάνει, καὶ δι᾿ οἰνοχοΐαν τοῦ Γανυμήδους τῇ παιδεραστίᾳ σεμνύνεται; Τί μοι σέβειν θεοὺς δωρολήπτας, καὶ ὀργιζομένους ἂν μὴ λάβωσιν; Ἐχέτωσαν οὗτοι τὴν εἱμαρμένην· τοὺς πλανήτας προσκυνεῖν οὐ βούλομαι. Τίς ἐστιν ὁ Βερενίκης πλόκαμος; Ποῦ δὲ οἱ ἀστέρες αὐτῆς πρὶν τὴν προειρημένην ἀποθανεῖν; Πῶς δὲ ὁ τεθνεὼς Ἀντίνοος μειράκιον ἐν τῇ σελήνῃ ὡραῖον καθίδρυται; Τίς ὁ ἀναβιβάσας αὐτόν, εἰ μή τις καὶ τοῦτον, ὡς τοὺς βασιλέας μισθοῦ δι᾿ ἐπιορκίας τις, τοὺς θεοὺς καταγελῶν, εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν ἀνεληλυθέναι φήσας πεπίστευται, κατὰ τὸ ὅμοιον θεολογήσας τιμῆς καὶ δωρεᾶς ἠξίωται; Τί μοι τὸν θεον σεσυλήκατε; Τί δὲ αὐτοῦ τὴν ποίησιν ἀτιμάζετε; Θύεις πρόβατον, τὸ δ᾿ αὐτὸ προσκυνεῖς· ταῦρός ἐστιν ἐν οὐρανῷ, καὶ τὴν εἰκόνα σφάττεις αὐτοῦ. Ζῶον πονηρὸν ὁ ἐνγόνασι ἐκθλίβει· καὶ τὸν ἀνθρωποποιὸν Προμηθία καταφαγών ἀετὸς τετίμηται.Καλὸς ὁ κύκνος, ὅτι μοιχὸς ἦν· καλοὶ δὲ καὶ οἱ ἑτεροήμεροι Διόσκουροι, τῶν Λευκιππίδων οἱ ἁρπασταί. Κρείττων ἡ Ἑλένη, τὸν μὲν καρήξανθον Μενέλαον καταλιποῦσα, τῷ δὲ μιτρηφόρῳ καὶ πολυχρύσῳ Πάριδι κατακολουθοῦσα. Λίκαιος καὶ Σώφρων, ὁ τὴν ἐκπορνεύσασαν εἰς Ἠλύσια πεδία μετατεθεικώς. Ἀλλ᾿ οὐδὲ ἡ Τυνδαρὶς ἀπηθανάτισται· καὶ σοφῶς ὁ Εὐριπίδης ὑπὸ Ὀρέστου τῆς προειρημένης γυναικὸς τὴν ἀναίρεσιν παρεισήγαγε.
pass_a_gloss: Transformation is mythologized for humans; but also the gods are transformed among you. The Rea becomes a tree, and Zeus becomes a serpent through Persephatta, the sisters of Phaethon become poplars, and Leto becomes a lowly animal, because of which Delos is now called Ortygia. Tell me, does God become a swan, and take on the form of an eagle, and is he honored because of the wine-pouring of Ganymede and his pederasty? Why should I reverence gods who are bribed and become angry if they do not receive? Let them have their fate; I do not wish to worship the planets. What is the lock of Berenice? And where are her stars before the aforementioned woman died? And how is the dead Antinous, a beautiful youth, established in the moon? Who has lifted him up, if not someone who, like the kings for a wage through perjury, mocking the gods, has said that he has gone up into heaven, and has been deemed worthy of honor and gift according to the same theology? What have you plundered from God? And why do you dishonor his creation? You sacrifice a sheep, and yet you worship it; a bull is in heaven, and you slaughter its image. A wicked animal, the eagle, tears to pieces; and the eagle that devoured the creator Prometheus is honored. The swan is beautiful because it was an adulterer; and the Dioscuri, the abductors of the Leucippides, are beautiful. Helen is better, having left behind the feeble Menelaus and having followed the mitre-wearing and rich Paris. Lycaon and Sophron, who transferred the one who was prostituted to the Elysian fields. But not even Tyndareus has been deified; and wisely Euripides introduced the destruction of the aforementioned woman by Orestes.

choices.why: πεδία is a common noun for fields
Ἠλύσιος is an adjective for Elysian

pass_b_english: Transformation has been turned into myth for human beings, yet your gods also undergo metamorphosis. Rhea becomes a tree; Zeus turns into a serpent for the sake of Persephone. The sisters of Phaethon become poplars, and Leto becomes a lowly creature, on account of whom Ortygia is now called Delos. Tell me, does God become a swan and assume the form of an eagle, and is he honored because of Ganymede's cupbearing and his pederasty? Why should I reverence gods who take bribes and grow angry if they do not receive them? Let them keep their fate; I refuse to worship the planets. What is the lock of Berenice? Where were her stars before the aforementioned woman died? How is the dead Antinous, a beautiful youth, established in the moon? Who lifted him up, if not someone who, like kings for a wage through perjury, mocked the gods and claimed he had ascended into heaven, and who, by the same theology, was deemed worthy of honor and a gift? What have you stolen from God? And why do you dishonor his creation? You sacrifice a sheep yet worship it; a bull is in heaven, and you slaughter its image. A wicked animal, the eagle, tears to pieces; and the eagle that devoured the creator Prometheus is honored. The swan is beautiful because it was an adulterer; the Dioscuri, abductors of the Leucippides, are also beautiful. Helen is better, having left behind the feeble Menelaus and followed the mitre-wearing, rich Paris. Lycaon and Sophron transferred the woman who was prostituted to the Elysian fields. Not even Tyndareus has been deified; and Euripides wisely introduced the destruction of the aforementioned woman by Orestes.

review.notes: Pass A and Pass B both fail to correctly translate the relationship between Ortygia and Delos. The Greek text says 'δι᾿ ἣν Ὀρτυγία Δῆλος ἡ νῦν κέκληται' (because of which Ortygia is now called Delos). Pass A says 'Delos is now called Ortygia' (reversing the names) and Pass B says 'Ortygia is now called Delos' (which is a possible interpretation but the Greek structure 'Ortygia [is] Delos now called' suggests Ortygia is the subject being renamed). More critically, Pass A fails on 'Τί μοι τὸν θεον σεσυλήκατε?' (What have you plundered from God? / What have you stolen from God?). Pass A translates 'σεσυλήκατε' as 'plundered', but the context of the Greek 'σεσυλήκατε' (from συλαίω) is better rendered as 'stolen' or 'robbed', which Pass B handles, but Pass A's translation of the preceding clause 'κατὰ τὸ ὅμοιον θεολογήσας τιμῆς καὶ δωρεᾶς ἠξίωται' is slightly clumsy compared to the Greek. However, the primary failure is the reversal of the names Ortygia and Delos in Pass A: 'Delos is now called Ortygia' contradicts 'Ὀρτυγία Δῆλος ἡ νῦν κέκληται'.
reasons: Pass A reverses the names in the clause 'δι᾿ ἣν Ὀρτυγία Δῆλος ἡ νῦν κέκληται' by stating 'Delos is now called Ortygia' instead of 'Ortygia is now called Delos'.
